first_error_behavior: Validate and Save stop at the first source-ordered failure; popup row checks run when adding or saving popup rows.

rules.condition: Month equals 00.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Month field on Page 1 Item 1 is required.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.official_behavior: The gate is date-based, but the message incorrectly describes only the year.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: State that this revision applies only to transactions after March 31, 2021.

rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid e-mail address on page 1 item 10
rules.official_behavior: validateEmail is defined but never called by Validate or the email control.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Invoke format validation from the shared validation graph.

rules.condition: A date control contains an invalid MM/DD/YYYY date.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Please provide a valid date. (MM/DD/YYYY format)
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: A valid date is after today.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: This date cannot be a future date.
rules.official_behavior: The field clears, but isValid remains true and the function returns true.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Set false and return false after clearing.

rules.condition: A valid date has a year before 2018.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: This date cannot be prior to 2018.
rules.official_behavior: The field clears, but isValid remains true and the function returns true.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Set false and return false after clearing.

rules.condition: A tax rate is at least 100.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Tax rate should be below 100.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: A tax rate is negative.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: checkRate enforces only the upper bound, so a negative rate is accepted.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require a rate from zero through less than 100.

rules.condition: Any validateAll rule fails.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: First validateAll message.
rules.official_behavior: Save invokes the full Validate graph, then redundantly checks RDO again.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use the same shared graph without the redundant RDO branch.
